question: In the wave description of a particle (Quantum Mechanics), the matter wave is associated with a probability density. According to Max Born's interpretation, which quantity is directly proportional to the probability of finding the particle at a specific point?

options.A: The amplitude of the wave function ($|\Psi|$)
options.B: The square of the amplitude of the wave function ($|\Psi|^2$)
